title: Omnichannel Workflows: Contact Center and CRM Automation | CrestApps for Orchard Core
description:
A contact center produces moments that need follow-up: a call nobody answered, a dialer attempt that rang out, a lead that qualifies. Workflows in CrestApps for Orchard Core react to those events and act on them with no code: send a text, schedule a callback, queue an activity, hand a conversation to a person, control call recording, or convert a lead.

In this video:
• Why workflows, and how one is put together
• Creating a workflow in Design, Workflows
• The Contact Center Event: Event type, its groups, and the Matched and Ignored outcomes
• Adding a task, and building a Send Text Message workflow
• The settings of every contact center task
• The CRM event Lead Converted and the Convert Lead task
• How each task ends, and the runs of a workflow
• Workflows to start from, and what stays with people

The demo site has no phone or text provider connected, so the workflow that needs a real dialer call is built but not run.
